photo.alt: Iceland from orbit on a cloud-free day
photo.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2020, European Space Agency, via Wikimedia Commons

facts: About 376,000 people (2022), roughly a third of them in Reykjavík
worth_knowing: Iceland sits on a rift between tectonic plates, which is why it has geysers and frequent eruptions. Its parliament, the Althing, dates from around 930 and is one of the world's oldest.
